verses.1: And he made the altar of worship. It had five cubits in length, five cubits in width, and three cubits in height.
verses.2: And he made horns on all four of his sides. From those horns, he created something that resembled horns.
verses.3: And he made all the utensils used in the sacrifice: the bowls, the containers for holding water, and all the other utensils. He crafted them all with great care.
verses.4: And he made the altar into a work of magic, like a cunningly crafted device, from the top down, all the way to half its height.
verses.5: And he made four bases at each of the four corners, for the four corners of the house.
verses.6: And he made the frames of the pillars from cypress wood. He then covered them with gold.
verses.7: And he brought the banners onto the sides of the altar, so that they could be used to carry it there. He made them into a structure for carrying it.
verses.8: And he made the altar of wood, and also the chest of wood, in order to hold the vessels that were used during the worship services.
verses.9: And he built the house of Phat with stone walls. The stones used for the walls were six hundred and fifty cubits long.
verses.10: Their arms are each forty in number, and their hands also have forty nails. Their nails are made of gold.
verses.11: And from each of the two hundred statues, there were forty in number. Their hands and feet were also made of gold.
verses.12: And on the sides of the sea, there were fifty columns. Each column had twelve bases, and each base had twelve capitals. The capitals themselves were made of gold.
verses.13: And before that, from the east, there were fifty miles.
verses.14: They were five and a half amahs long, with their handles also three in number.
verses.15: And from this side to the other, to the gate of the courtyard, there are fifteen amahs standing there. Their arms are also three in number.
verses.16: All the nails in the garden are around six meters away.
verses.17: And the idols are made of gold and silver. Their heads are also covered with gold and silver. All the idols in the temple are made of gold and silver.
verses.18: And the door of the courtyard was made from materials like wood and metal. There were also two bolts and thirteen nails used in its construction. The length of it was forty cubits, and its width was five cubits, enough for the doors of the courtyard.
verses.19: And their hands were four in number, and their fingers also were four. Their nails were like gold. Their heads and faces were as precious as gold.
verses.20: And all the doors to the house and the surrounding courtyard were covered with tiles.
verses.21: These are the regulations regarding the tent. These regulations were established by Moses, based on the work done by the Levites under the leadership of Ithamar, son of Aaron, the priest.
verses.22: And in Zeliel, son of Uri, son of Hur, for the tribe of Judah, he did all that Jehovah commanded Moses to do.
verses.23: And Hehielam, son of Ahisamach, was responsible for the construction of the Temple of Dan. He was skilled in carpentry and construction work. He also designed the structure’s layout and structure.
verses.24: All the gold used for making sacred objects was of a purity of fifty and ten pieces per coin. It also included seven tons of gold, which was equivalent to thirty shekels in terms of its purity.
verses.25: And the silver that was given by the assembly was one thousand seven hundred and fifty-seven shekels, according to the standard weight.
verses.26: Half a shekel’s weight is required for each item that is used in the sacrifices. This applies to all those who carry out these rituals, from the age of forty years up to sixty thousand, and even more.
verses.27: And it became like a silver plate, used to hold the sacred vessels and other precious items. It was made into plates for holding these items, just like silver plates are used for holding other things.
verses.28: And he made the thousand and seventy-five units, as well as fifty-seven units. He also created warriors for the army. Their heads were shaped like arrows, and they were very dangerous.
verses.29: And the pieces of pottery that were broken were seventy, and also one hundred and forty-four tons in weight.
verses.30: And he made there the doors of the sanctuary, as well as the altar of the incense and the ark of the covenant that belonged to him. And also all the utensils used for worship.
verses.31: And all the doors of the courtyard, and all the doors of the gate of the courtyard, and all the windows of the house, and all the windows of the courtyard around.
